purpose: New creature surface albedos for the experimental refinement; original files preserved alongside this manifest.
skin: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square base-color texture for an original horror creature's 3D skin, not a concept painting. Extreme close flat scan-like view of a 40 cm patch of pallid sickly ash-beige dermis: delicate blue-grey subdermal capillaries, irregular stretched pores, healed thin scars, minute creases, waxy desiccated areas and subtle discolored mottling. Restrained subtle color variation, mostly middle-light beige grey with faint olive undertones, no large black patches. Photographic material specificity, clinically even diffuse illumination, no cast shadows or specular highlights, no ambient occlusion painted into color. Edge-to-edge material, approximately tileable on both axes with inconspicuous boundaries, no large directional landmark. No body silhouette, no face, no eyes, no wound opening, no organs, no lettering, no borders, no objects, no background. Material must read as real organic skin rather than stone, camouflage, metal, rubber, or procedural noise. 2048x2048 square.
raw: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square base-color material for a fictional creature's exposed tendon and muscle on a 3D model. Flat scan-like view of a 30 cm surface specimen: desaturated dark dusty burgundy and warm grey sinewy longitudinal fascicles interwoven with fine pale connective fibers, layered semi-translucent striations and subtle stretched membranes. Detailed biological fiber organization, restrained variation, no dripping blood or liquid. Even diffuse scan lighting, no cast shadows, no gloss highlights, no painted global illumination. Edge-to-edge approximately tileable material, no recognizable body part, no organs, no faces, no eyes, no wounds, no text, no borders, no props. Avoid candy red, shiny plastic, rope patterns, thick uniform stripes. Photographic material detail with natural uneven fiber widths. 2048x2048 square.
chitin: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square base-color texture for a sculpted 3D horror creature carapace. Orthographic flat scan-like macro surface of dark umber-grey horn and chitin: irregular overlapping fine keratin lamellae, chipped worn ridges, minute pits, scraped ivory-brown edges, faint natural growth striations and dried seams. Middle-dark grey brown overall, softly varied without deep black islands. Photographic natural material, no manufactured paneling, no reptile hexagons, no regular scales, no rock texture. Soft even diffuse lighting with no cast shadow, AO or specular hotspot baked in. Edge-to-edge approximately tileable in both axes, uniform detail scale, no creature silhouette, no eyes, no faces, no text, no borders, no background. 2048x2048 square.
bone: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square base-color material for a fictional 3D creature's teeth, claws and exposed bone ridges. Flat scan-like ivory dentine and weathered bone surface, warm grey beige with subtle yellowing, minute vascular pinholes, fine dry fissures, delicate natural longitudinal striation and rubbed pale edges. Material predominantly pale midtone, not pure white, very restrained stains. Realistic microscopic detail over a 25 cm area. Even diffuse illumination, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or gloss highlights baked into color. Approximately tileable edge-to-edge in both axes. No recognizable skeleton or body part, no skulls, no faces, no eyes, no text, no border, no objects, no background. Avoid marble veining, rock grain and synthetic noise. 2048x2048 square.
